title: JPMorgan Chase (JPM) Lands $20 Billion Mandate As Dealmaking Hits Record Levels
title_zh: JPMorgan Chase (JPM) Lands $20 Billion Mandate As Dealmaking Hits Record Levels
summary: JPMorgan Chase (NYSE:JPM) and Qatar Investment Authority agreed a US$20b multi market investment partnership covering public equities and private credit. The alliance is led by J.P. Morgan Asset Management and allocates capital across several regions and asset classes for QIA.
